scenarios.name: Missing Candidate Model File
scenarios.expected_behavior: Immediate graceful fallback to production baseline model
scenarios.observed_behavior: Baseline loaded and served request in 36.15 ms

scenarios.name: Corrupted Candidate Checkpoint File
scenarios.injected_fault: Corrupted/truncated binary file on checkpoint load
scenarios.expected_behavior: Catch unpickling error and fall back to baseline
scenarios.observed_behavior: Corrupt checkpoint caught; baseline fallback completed in 50.45 ms

scenarios.name: Inference Timeout Handling
scenarios.injected_fault: Candidate latency artificially delayed past timeout limit
scenarios.expected_behavior: Timeout aborts candidate branch and serves fast baseline result
scenarios.observed_behavior: Guarded execution returned valid baseline output in 11.36 ms

scenarios.name: Out-of-Memory Fallback
scenarios.injected_fault: MemoryError raised during memory-intensive patch extraction
scenarios.expected_behavior: Catch allocation error and execute low-memory whole-image fallback
scenarios.observed_behavior: OOM intercepted, low-memory fallback completed in 11.40 ms

scenarios.name: NaN/Inf Output Handling
scenarios.injected_fault: Simulated uncalibrated weights returning NaN/Inf tensors
scenarios.expected_behavior: Detect invalid numeric values, suppress output, fallback to baseline
scenarios.observed_behavior: NaN/Inf successfully quarantined, healthy baseline served in 18.63 ms

scenarios.name: Unexpected Input Dimensions & Color Formats
scenarios.expected_behavior: Input adapter normalizes channels and resizes cleanly without error
scenarios.observed_behavior: All 4 anomalous formats normalized and evaluated in 102.38 ms

scenarios.name: Empty / Truncated Image File
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reject payload with descriptive validation error; do not crash backend
scenarios.observed_behavior: Zero-byte file intercepted, sanitized rejection generated in 112.29 ms

scenarios.name: Disk Full During Shadow Logging
scenarios.injected_fault: OSError(28, 'No space left on device') during shadow write
scenarios.expected_behavior: Shadow logging errors must never fail the primary citizen request
scenarios.observed_behavior: Disk failure caught; primary response returned cleanly in 0.01 ms

scenarios.name: Rapid Consecutive Failures (Circuit Breaker)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Circuit breaker trips to OPEN; candidate bypassed with zero overhead
scenarios.observed_behavior: Circuit breaker tripped to OPEN; baseline bypass executed in 13.17 ms

scenarios.name: Dynamic Fallback to Baseline
scenarios.injected_fault: RuntimeError thrown inside candidate inference module
scenarios.expected_behavior: Transparent fallback to production baseline model
scenarios.observed_behavior: Baseline served request without client disruption in 16.86 ms

scenarios.name: Dual-Model Catastrophic Failure
scenarios.injected_fault: Both candidate and baseline models encounter runtime errors
scenarios.expected_behavior: Return structured degraded fallback response; flag ticket for manual review
scenarios.observed_behavior: Graceful degraded payload returned without crash in 0.01 ms

scenarios.name: Process Cold Start Recovery Time
scenarios.injected_fault: Fresh cold-start process instantiation simulating container restart
scenarios.expected_behavior: Model weights loaded and first inference served in < 500 ms
